name: EmptyState
description:
What a list, table or pane shows when it has nothing — or failed to load — in the same box
the content would have used (R9.1, R16.4). It fills its box and lays out against it:

  row     height < 10rem: icon, line and action in one row (a table body, a short list)
  block   10–16rem: centred, icon in a soft tile
  large   ≥ 16rem: centred, the 2xl icon in a larger tile
signature: ({ icon, children, action, tone, className, ...rest }: EmptyStateProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: action
props.description: The primary way forward, if there is one: a small Button ("Clear search").

props.name: icon
props.description: The thing that is missing (search, endpoint, inbox…). Pass it without a size.

props.name: tone
props.description: `danger` for an error that occupies the same box (couldn't load).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
